schema.description: Details of the assigned task.

form_id.description: Identifier of the form linked to the task.

form_name.description: Name of the form linked to the task.

location_code.description: Code of the location linked to the task.

location_name.description: Name of the location linked to the task.

location_email.description: Email address registered for the location.

location_phone.description: Phone number registered for the location.

company_name.description: Name of the company linked to the location.

company_code.description: Code of the company linked to the location.

start_time.description: Date and time when the task is scheduled to start.

date.description: Scheduled date broken down into parts.

estimated_time.description: Estimated duration of the task in minutes.

user_name.description: Full name of the assigned user.

user_email.description: Email address of the assigned user.

user_phone.description: Phone number of the assigned user.

late_response_allowed.description: Indicates whether a late response is allowed. Available only when extended fields are enabled.

mandatory.description: Who the task is mandatory for: for_nobody, for_one, or for_everyone. Available only when extended fields are enabled.

asset_id.description: Identifier of the asset linked to the task, when one exists.

asset_code.description: Code of the asset linked to the task, when one exists.

planning.description: Planning linked to the task, available when planning is enabled.

asset_id.description: Identifier of the asset linked to the planning.

cancelled_at.description: Date and time when the task was cancelled, when applicable.

cancellation_reason.description: Reason why the task was cancelled, when applicable.

delete.description: Unsubscribes a webhook. Called automatically by the platform when a flow is turned off, updated, or deleted. Required so the platform knows this operation exists: the subscribe responses above return this same path in the Location header, but without a matching delete operation declared here, the platform never calls it.

parameters.description: Identifier of the account that owns the subscription.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Unique token that authorizes the deletion of this specific subscription.
